description: This file defines the DashboardViewModel class, which manages the data and logic for the dashboard screen in an Android app. It provides observable data such as analytics summaries and recent trades, and handles loading data asynchronously via an executor.

classes.name: DashboardViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel for the Dashboard screen, providing live data for analytics summary and recent trades, and managing data loading asynchronously.

methods.name: loadDashboard
methods.description: Loads dashboard data, fetching analytics summary and recent trades asynchronously, updating observable LiveData objects.
